issue_gist: RegulaFalsiSolver fails to converge on a simple monotonic function, exceeding the 100-evaluation limit and throwing a MaxCount exceeded exception, because the regula falsi implementation keeps one bracket endpoint stuck and converges only linearly or slowly. PegasusSolver solves the same problem in 17 evaluations.
